title: UBI won’t save us, and the nurse will tell you why
summary: Summary withheld: an Opus review found that the machine-written summary did not match the post. Read the original post.

quotes.text: The nurse, unfortunately, is the kind of worker whose no the society cannot accept. This freedom would never be universal.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the central argument that UBI cannot truly be universal for essential workers who cannot be permitted to leave their jobs

quotes.text: Whoever owns the machines owns the money, and they are nobody's charity. The check stops at the border.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains why global wealth redistribution through UBI is unlikely and why inequality would increase internationally
